title: The Seeds of Scheming: Weakness of Will in the Building Blocks of Agentic Systems
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs' moral judgment and ethical alignment by querying them about 'scheming' and analyzing their responses through the lenses of utilitarianism, deontology, and virtue ethics. It uses the philosophical concept of akrasia (weakness of will) to benchmark internal consistency and self-control in agentic systems.
